item.tib: bskal stong sangs rgyas brgyad stong gis / thugs bstan lnga brgya'i gdung tshab gshen / dran pa nam mkha'i mdog 'chang ba'i / zab gsang gzungs mchog rgyal po
item.note: the final text in this section was found at spa-gro stag-tshang, and passed on to gra-pa mtshungs-med bsod-nams blo-gros.
